title: A countable integer combination of oriented rectifiable pieces with finite total mass is integer multiplicity (Simon 3.8–3.9)
statement: Assume (TL): for all P', n' ∈ ℕ, every open U' ⊆ ℝ^{P'} and all Borel A ⊆ B ⊆ U' with Hⁿ'(B ∩ C) < ∞ for every compact C ⊆ U', for Hⁿ'-a.e. x ∈ A and every subspace Q, B has approximate tangent space Q at x iff A does. Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, and for j ∈ ℕ let N_j ⊆ U be Borel and countably n-rectifiable, g_j : ℝ^P → ℤ measurable with g_j(y) ≠ 0 for y ∈ N_j, and η_j : ℝ^P → Λ_n(ℝ^P) strongly measurable such that for Hⁿ-a.e. y ∈ N_j, η_j(y) is a unit orientation of an approximate tangent space of N_j at y. Assume Σ_j ∫⁻_{N_j} |g_j| dHⁿ < ∞ and let Q ∈ 𝒟_n(U) satisfy Q(ω) = Σ_j ∫_{N_j} g_j(y)·η_j(y)(ω(y)) dHⁿ(y) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U). Then Q is integer multiplicity (IsIntegerMultiplicity Q).
lean_statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U A B : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet A → MeasurableSet B → A ⊆ B → B ⊆ U → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μHE[n] (B ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict A), ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n B x Q ↔ HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n A x Q) → ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (N : ℕ → Set (Euclid P)) (g : ℕ → Euclid P → ℤ) (η : ℕ → Euclid P → MultiVector P n) (Q : GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsOpen U → (∀ j, MeasurableSet (N j)) → (∀ j, N j ⊆ U) → (∀ j, CountablyRectifiable n (N j)) → (∀ j, Measurable (g j)) → (∀ j, ∀ y ∈ N j, g j y ≠ 0) → (∀ j, StronglyMeasurable (η j)) → (∀ j, ∀ᵐ y ∂(μHE[n].restrict (N j)), ∃ T : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n (N j) y T ∧ IsUnitOrientationOf (η j y) T) → ∑' j, ∫⁻ y in N j, ((g j y).natAbs : ℝ≥0∞) ∂μHE[n] ≠ ∞ → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, Q ω = ∑' j, ∫ y in N j, (g j y : ℝ) * η j y ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) y) ∂μHE[n]) → IsIntegerMultiplicity Q
